description: Rochers-de-Naye is the limestone crest above Veytaux, and the frame stays on the rocky ridge beside a plain summit building. Lake Geneva is only a dark shape under the cloud, and the shore castle is not the subject. Late-September grass and rock are shown without a snowfield. This replaces Chillon, already published. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and cool, about 8°C, with full cloud cover, a light wind, and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
